decision.summary: NO_ACTION: the 80k DIP thesis already paid today, and stale account state blocks any further action.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. The latest Beecthor map stayed bearish enough to allow a sweep into 80.2k and below, and by the 14:00 snapshot BTC is around 78685, so that downside thesis has already played out. Trade log shows the daily thesis position `will-bitcoin-dip-to-80k-on-may-15` Yes was fully closed at 13:08 UTC for take-profit, so there is no legitimate position left to reduce or close again. At the same time, `account_state.json` is stale and still shows that position as open from its 12:01 sync, which means reconciliation is currently broken. Under the playbook, that alone blocks any new opening, and the post-win daily cooldown also blocks any additional BTC daily entry for the rest of this UTC day because a daily position already exited via take-profit today.
